summary.name: Vanilla
summary.one_liner: Vanilla is a free Mac menu bar app that hides your menu bar icons, with an optional one-time-purchase Pro version for extra customization.
use_cases: hide clutter from the Mac menu bar
create a minimalist Mac desktop setup
toggle menu bar icons with a keyboard shortcut
keep rarely used menu bar icons out of sight
summary.what_it_does: Vanilla is a Mac app that hides menu bar icons when you toggle it. The free version is described as easy to use: download, launch, and follow the prompts. Vanilla Pro adds a custom keyboard shortcut to toggle menu bar and desktop icons, a "Completely Removed" section whose icons only show in the preferences window, auto-hide that conceals icons five seconds after toggling, and an option to start at login. A Pro license activation code can be used up to 10 times across multiple Macs.
notable: Free core app for hiding menu bar icons
Pro keyboard shortcut to toggle menu bar and desktop icons
Completely Removed icons section visible only in preferences
One-time Pro purchase; each license code usable on up to 10 Macs
caveats: Pro features require a one-time paid purchase
Each Pro license activation code can be used up to 10 times
